data.content_ref: inline:The problem restricts evidence to 'a single evaluation,' but SRC_001's transfer_claims require 'measur[ing] the complexity of the feature integration' and determining whether a task lies in the substitutive or tacit domain — a structural/theoretical diagnosis that cannot be performed within a single evaluation. By grounding its entire argument in an empirically untestable (under the stated constraint) structural impossibility, SRC_001 fails to identify any evidence available in the single evaluation that distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere compliance, thus not answering the problem as stated.
